entities.name: April 9 Tragedy and Independence
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: April 9 Tragedy and Independence, a transformative movement in Georgia (1989–1991). Emerged from Soviet troops kill 21 peaceful protesters in Tbilisi with poison gas and shovels and Georgia declares independence from the Soviet Union. Catalyzed Civil Wars and Shevardnadze Era.
